title: The Accuracy of Automated Audiometry Application on Smart Phone to Screen Hearing Loss
brief_summary: The purpose of study is to determine the diagnostic value of Hearing test program on smart phone for detected patients who has hearing loss.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient who underwent hearing test in our otologic clinic

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age below 15 year
* Patients who cannot following command
study_population: Patient who underwent hearing test in our otologic clinic
